blocks.text: MINNEAPOLIS — Norman Powell scored 23 points, Matas Buzelis added 18 points and nine rebounds, and the short-handed Chicago Bulls won for the second night in a row with a 117-106 victory over the Minnesota Timberwolves in the NBA on Saturday. Buddy Hield and Tre Jones each chipped in 16 points off the bench for the Bulls, who ended Minnesota’s five-game winning streak convincingly.
